scope: Existing MCP-Atlas catalog update and two evidence records; no new benchmark

catalog_updates.version: Harness v2 at e3dfef3ce93287c3d7b9e765c3a021f252eefbff; HF HEAD observed 8c563b55d7c967755f474299848049834d624617
catalog_updates.task_form: Controlled real MCP tool menus, agent loop, claim-based final-answer judge; public500/full1000 separate
catalog_updates.metric: Mean claim coverage and task pass at coverage>=0.75; model/groundtruth inner join and valid-score denominator must be recorded
catalog_updates.limitations: Actual public task/trajectory and source path read; 15 synthetic scoring tests with mocked judge only. No live MCP, LLM, judge or full leaderboard run. Current harness differs from original paper.

records.depth_scope: Complete real public task/trajectory; v2 loop, output extraction, scoring and statistics source
records.finding: Primary judge sees claim/response, not trajectory; compact is truncation rather than summarization; attempted calls consume budget. Error rows, missing claims, absent task rows and judge-call failures have different denominator behavior.
records.limitations: No live runtime verification. Source-level shared-sandbox/reset observations are not a demonstrated cross-task leak.

records.depth_scope: 15 synthetic scoring/merge/statistics assertions, all judge calls mocked
records.finding: Judge failure maps claim to zero; empty output maps task to zero; missing claims maps None excluded from statistics; inner join drops absent tasks and keeps duplicate output IDs. Auxiliary clean_runs counter can double-subtract.
records.limitations: No actual prevalence or published-score impact established; not an online judge-quality or agent-capability experiment.
